changelog:
🆕 Accounts that Kiro moves to its newer CreateResponse chat API keep working: the proxy checks each account's Kiro flag and sends its chat to that API instead of answering 429. Settings → Kiro endpoint → Chat API can also send every account to one API.
⚖️ Weighted routing now gives each account its weight's share of requests; a heavy account used to get no more than any other.
🔝 Account priority now goes higher first: every account starts at 0, so raising one account puts it first. Saved priorities are turned around once and keep their order.
🔄 Requests advertise the Kiro IDE's current release, read from Kiro's update feed once a day and again whenever Kiro refuses the old one.
